items.title_orig: Round two, London! From his start at Kerrang! to his role as editor-in-chief of Music Week, George Garner...
items.article_text:
Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (CAROUSEL_ALBUM), 2026-11-13T09:03:02+0000.

Legenda original:
Round two, London! From his start at Kerrang! to his role as editor-in-chief of Music Week, George Garner has interviewed everyone from Dolly Parton to Wu-Tang Clan to Pearl Jam. 

Today, he’ll sit down with Jeff and Barry Ament at Crypt on the Green to talk about Since Forever and revisit Pearl Jam’s early years through Jeff’s photos and the stories behind them.
